semantic.justification: Original SAXParseException value uses actual SAXException inheritance, four declared members, shared CPPU metadata and real Any copy/extraction. Native documentbuilder error formatting preserves ASCII_US, line/int2 and empty identifier/context/wrapped defaults. IO callbacks use actual input streams and byte sequences, preserve close/freeOnClose statement order, and contain only UNO exceptions. Builder orchestration, UCB entity resolver/URI fallback and service registration remain unported; no alternate DocumentBuilder or fake process context is advertised. Native threading/ABI, complete upstream parser QA and DOCX/XLSX file/UI acceptance remain unverified. Native IO function addresses and void* userdata now lower to shared module-lifetime callback entries and an opaque native address for each actual UNO-owning context. The address is not a copied C++ Reference layout or an alternate stream owner. Only the source context destructor unregisters and frees it; source empty/failed close branches are not repaired.
